summary: The audit checks 45 units, every course letter graded with a B+ or better (research courses offered only S/NC excepted): PHYSICS 212 and 220 and one quantum course, each for at least 3 units. Checked by hand: two 3-unit graduate courses in Physics or Applied Physics, which you move in, the 3-unit minimum for your other courses, the 3.3 GPA, replacement courses if your PhD waived PHYSICS 212, 220 or a quantum elective, and a petition to waive up to six required units if you submit a thesis.
